global_style: A sophisticated dark-mode tech template featuring vibrant neon gradients, particle abstractions, and an elegant serif typography mix.

identity_anchors: Deep violet/navy dark backgrounds with dynamic 3D particle graphics
Elegant serif fonts for primary headings contrasting with tech visuals
Vibrant cyan, magenta, and orange gradients used as functional highlights
Thin glowing borders for inactive elements and full color for active elements

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
